At the office · location checked about once an hour
Outside the office · your route is recorded about every 15 min

During work hours, from check-in to check-out, NEXUS checks where you are about once an hour while you are at the office, and follows your route (about every 15 minutes) when you leave it, even when the app is closed or not in use. Nothing is recorded before check-in or after check-out. A long absence from the office can then be seen and covered by a permit. Your manager and the BoD can see that day\'s trail. A notification stays on while it runs.\n\nIf you say no, your day shows \"location off\" on the board.
Keep it running after a restart
Allow NEXUS to use location \"all the time\", so the work session resumes by itself if the phone restarts.
On the next screen choose \"Allow all the time\" for Location, so the work session resumes by itself if the phone restarts. It is still only used between check-in and check-out.
Keep NEXUS from being put to sleep
Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery, and then the work session stops recording. Allow NEXUS to run in the background.
Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO: turn on Autostart, set Battery saver to \"No restrictions\", and lock NEXUS in recent apps.
Oppo / Realme / OnePlus: turn on Auto launch (\"Allow background activity\") and set battery to \"Don\'t optimize\".
Vivo / iQOO: allow high background power consumption and turn on Autostart.
Samsung: set Battery to \"Unrestricted\" and keep NEXUS out of \"Sleeping apps\".
Huawei / Honor: in App launch, manage NEXUS manually and allow all three switches.
